title: The Telangana Regulation of Trade in Indian Made Foreign Liquor, Foreign Liquor Act, 1993.
full_text: The Telangana Regulation of Trade in Indian Made Foreign Liquor, Foreign Liquor Act, 1993. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 199315 Act Number: 15 Enactment Date: 1993-09-04 Act Year: 1993 Short Title: The Telangana Regulation of Trade in Indian Made Foreign Liquor, Foreign Liquor Act, 1993. Long Title: An Act to provide for the taking over of the Wholesale Trade and Distribution in Indian Liquor, Foreign Liquor, Wine and Beer and to Regulate the Retail Trade thereof as a prelude to totally prohibit the consumption of intoxicating liquors. Privilege fee etc., under sections 23(1), 23-A and 23-B of the Telangana Excise Act to be the income of the Government. Section 5.
